title: College Football
description:
Nebraska at Rutgers
The Cornhuskers (5-4) travel to SHI Stadium to face the Scarlet Knights (2-7) in a Big Ten matchup. Nebraska seeks to snap a four-game skid and fell 24-13 to Illinois, while Rutgers seeks to snap a three-game skid and fell 31-10 to Wisconsin.

title: College Football
description:
Washington at Michigan State
The Spartans (3-6, 1-5) fly high into their Big Ten game against the Huskies (5-4, 2-4). Michigan State stunned rival Michigan 15-6 in the Big House last week. Washington has won four of five meetings with Michigan State after a 41-7 victory in 2023.
